scope: Descriptive extraction from primary text, not reproduced outcomes or invalidation using Third Eye variance

papers.units: 16 matched settings, not 16 independent repeats of one condition; seed 1; four trials per task
papers.reported_precision: 10,000 paired task-level bootstrap resamples; repeated trials not treated as independent tasks
papers.example_effect: AppWorld gpt-terra: +0.022 task-completion score, CI [0.006,0.040], 166 matched tasks
papers.selection_scoring: Online instruction-rule admission uses replay; each split is one continuous adaptation stream without separate learning/evaluation partition
papers.MDE_missing_reason: No transferable parent/continuation repeated-outcome design; example CI is not an MDE or seed-variance estimate
papers.comparison_limit: Fixed weights, context-rule adaptation; protected-regression statistic is conditional on replay-decided rejections

papers.units: Five seeds per configuration and loop; 100 budgeted experiments per run; 4,000 experiments total are not 4,000 independent policy replicates
papers.reported_precision: Mean and one standard deviation over five seeds; per-seed outcomes; do not reinterpret standard deviation bands as confidence intervals
papers.example_effect: Nanochat final baseline-relative improvement 10.7% with outcome store versus 8.4% for selection without store
papers.selection_scoring: Pre-execution proposal judgement then live run; store uses earlier observed outcomes
papers.MDE_missing_reason: Endpoint differences and their paired covariance are not extracted here; experiment counts alone do not give policy-level precision
papers.comparison_limit: Code-modification search; budgets count full training experiments rather than all proposal/judge inference

papers.units: Five runs per experimental condition, 40 generations each; underlying LLM weights fixed
papers.reported_precision: 95% run-level bootstrap intervals; generations are not independent runs
papers.example_effect: Table 7 coding matched-token AUBC: Selective IDM minus Reflective HyperAgents +1.21 scaled points, CI [-6.32,4.79]
papers.selection_scoring: Additional held-out task evaluation; candidate predictor updates validated on subsequent outcomes
papers.MDE_missing_reason: Bootstrap median intervals are not directly convertible to mean-effect power; no raw paired runs imported
papers.comparison_limit: Table 7 is one contrast, not a verdict on other primary comparisons or reported domains

papers.units: 1,300+ fine-tuning runs; 370 held-out run outcomes; one stated backbone
papers.reported_precision: Held-out prediction RMSE 1.47 percentage points and 95.1% of predictions within +/-3 percentage points
papers.example_effect: Prediction error, not a paired recursive admission-policy gain
papers.selection_scoring: Predict before full fine-tuning using static descriptors and a standardized training probe
papers.MDE_missing_reason: Prediction RMSE does not determine a policy-effect MDE; run dependence and repeat covariance not imported
papers.comparison_limit: Isolated training-run screening; cannot substitute its held-out sample count for recursive trajectory replication
